cohort: A weighted sample of 4399 women from Papua New Guinea was included in the study.
finding: About 10% of women in PNG provided prelacteal feeds to their infants, with higher odds observed among those with no or primary education, who had a caesarean section, gave birth at home or in the village, and were from the Islands region.
mod_finding: Women who had a caesarean section had significantly higher odds (AOR 4.1) of providing prelacteal feeds.
